Ingredients
25g cocoa powder
25g cocoa butter
12g powdered sugar

Heat the cocoa butter in a bain marie until it is liquid.

Mix in the powdered sugar.

Mix in the cocoa powder.

Carefully whisk until it is perfectly smooth.

Pour into any molds of your choice.

Let it cool down for an hour or so, then another hour in a fridge. You could cool it faster, but especially large tablets or other shapes will crack if they cool too quickly.

Pop it out and stick it in your mouth. Enjoy the taste.
